svg.aria-label: Two frustum slices cut lengthwise through the view axis and one corner, each inside the smallest circle around its corners, centred on the view axis. With a narrow 30 degree lens in 16:9, 57 degrees from corner to corner, and a long 4 to 20 m slice, the centre lies inside the slice and every corner is on the circle. With the test scene's 60 degree lens in 16:9, 99 degrees from corner to corner, and a 14 to 34 m slice, the centre stops on the far plane and the radius is about 40.04 m.
